thread:
samir.rao: Heads up \u2014 new hire Ahmed S's visa stamp got cancelled; next consulate slot is in 2 weeks. Manager asks if we can start him remotely from Pakistan and ship laptop. Anyone seen this recently?

anya.ramos: We do this occasionally. Need passport, I-797, DS-160, and signed offer uploaded. Also need his exact country for tax. We'll consult counsel about remote work while H-1B stamping pending.

lina.brown: Payroll note: if his US payroll start remains, benefits go live as normal. If we defer >30 days, benefits enrollment may need manual handling. Also shipping laptop internationally requires export checklist and asset hold tag.

samir.rao: Manager prefers ship and hold activation until he returns. Good to know about export. Any problems with I-9?

anya.ramos: I-9: remote inspection possible via authorized representative or vendor-approved process; if he completes inspection abroad we still need copies. I'll open an immigration ticket and loop counsel and I-9 vendor.

payroll-bot: Ticket created: IM-2026-430. Please attach docs here.

lina.brown: Action items: 1) Samir get docs uploaded, 2) Anya request counsel memo on remote work legality, 3) Payroll to review cross-border taxation, 4) Eng to prepare laptop hold tag.

samir.rao: Uploaded passport and I-797. Thanks all.

anya.ramos: Counsel asked for candidate address and expected return date. Samir please ask Ahmed. We'll aim to have employer letter and shipping approval within 24 hours.
